run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum sum subarray after removing one element from an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify correct maximum subarray sum computation
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses forward and backward Kadane passes to compute max subarray sum with one removal
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold algorithm that combines forward and backward max subarray arrays to find optimal single element removal
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a single pass approach instead of separate forward and backward Kadane passes
